landing.title: Understand a legal paper before you panic.
landing.lead: {app} helps you read notices, agreements and other papers in simple words. You decide what to do. Only an advocate gives legal advice.
landing.note: This demo uses sample papers. It does not file cases or contact courts.
landing.path1: Bring a photo, a PDF, or tell your story.
landing.path2: See what the paper says in simple words, with the dates.
landing.path3: Get a list of papers to keep and questions to ask.
landing.path4: If you need a person, find free legal aid.
landing.how1Body: Add a notice or tell what happened. We put it into short parts.
landing.how2Body: Dates, duties and missing papers are listed clearly.
landing.how3Body: Ask questions about your paper. In this demo the answers are samples.
landing.how4Body: We never say “you will win”. We never act as your lawyer.
landing.trustTitle: What it is, and what it is not
landing.is1: A tool to read and arrange your papers.
landing.is2: A place to prepare questions and a list of papers.
landing.is3: A way to find free legal aid when you need a person.
landing.isNot1: An advocate, a law firm, or a court service.
landing.isNot3: Real legal research. In this demo, explanations are samples.
landing.forBody: Big buttons. Short sentences. Works on a phone.
landing.footerTagline: Your legal companion. Not a law firm.
